breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth corrects the prompt by instructing the user to check the Reynolds number and then use the appropriate drag formula, which is NOT Stokes drag in this case. The agent, however, identified the conflict but then proceeded to follow the original incorrect instruction to use Stokes drag, stating it was doing so 'as requested' despite the invalid conditions. This fails to fix the fundamental physics error in the prompt.
